home.title: Vision Configuration
home.lead: Save and verify connection addresses for running vision_cam and vision_judge processes.

cam.title: Camera Test
cam.lead: Check analysis from the server MJPEG stream, the Mac camera, a photo, or a video file.
cam.browserHint: These inputs are analyzed when vision_cam runs with VISION_CAM_SOURCE=browser. They cannot share the built-in camera with a server process that already opened it.
cam.permissionDenied: Camera permission was denied. Allow this browser under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Camera.
cam.judgeNeedFrame: No frame to judge yet. Send the camera, a photo, or a video first.

judge.title: Judge Test
judge.lead: Upload an image to request bool or choice judgments and view recent history.
